newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cuts Suez by 25 cents v Brent for April.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cuts Suez by 25 cents v Brent for April.

text.p: Egypt has cut the April price of its Gulf of Suez blend by 25 cents a barrel against dated Brent, the state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) said on Sunday. The price in April will be dated Brent -$2.75, against Brent -$2.50 in March, it said in a statement.
EGPC also cut the prices of the other five grades by between five and 20 cents a barrel against dated Brent, it added.
